name: kmcp
description: K-MCP: open-source MCP servers for Korean & Japanese commerce. Works without keys: Korean business calendar (tax/payroll deadlines, holidays), HWP/HWPX reader, public data (address, business status), Japan sourcing bridge. With your own keys (see README): Naver Smart Store, Coupang, Cafe24, KakaoTalk, Toss Payments, Popbill, parcel tracking.
